question: Can Sobek identity be separated reproducibly from solar/crown/syncretic context across dated museum objects under blinded feature extraction and matched controls?

admission.source_rule: Museum or excavation catalogue with stable object identity and date/context. Exact image bytes must be SHA-256 sealed before image-derived scoring.

feature_annotators_hidden_from: period group during primary feature marking
blindness.unlock: Identity/context labels are joined only after feature packages are frozen.

controls.species_control: Crocodiles appearing as dangerous animals, including Horus-cippus contexts, must be represented so crocodile morphology alone cannot be equated automatically with the deity Sobek.
controls.crown_control: Non-Sobek deities with plumes, sun disks, horns, atef or uraei must be included so headgear alone cannot drive classification.
controls.syncretic_control: Falcon-headed crocodiles are a held-out contextual branch and are not relabeled to maximize fit.

primary_tests.prediction: Crocodilian core plus body mode classifies catalogue-identified Sobek above matched controls without crown features.
Adding sun-disk/crown modules improves discrimination of catalogue-identified Sobek-Re/solarized Sobek from non-solar Sobek, but crown modules alone do not identify Sobek reliably.
Falcon-headed crocodile objects are better modeled as a context-dependent branch than as the canonical Sobek core.
Core-vs-context separation generalizes to a held-out period group without feature or threshold retuning.
After the ancient classifier is frozen, the user-supplied SEBEK bottle emblem should be scored only as an out-of-sample modern visual query. Its result cannot establish designer intent.

wedjat_comparison_after_unlock.allowed: Compare architecture of feature roles: identity core vs contextual modules, hybrid anatomy, period effects and failure modes.
wedjat_comparison_after_unlock.forbidden: Do not infer a direct Sobek-Wedjat lineage, fraction mapping, text encoding or shared hidden code from structural analogy.

promotion.SOBEK_MULTILAYER_ICONOGRAPHIC_GRAMMAR_CA: T1, T2 and T4 replicate with matched controls and no retuning.
promotion.SOBEK_WEDJAT_SHARED_ARCHITECTURAL_PATTER: May be used only to describe the abstract analytical pattern core-plus-context; it is not a historical transmission claim.
